description: Filter and sort ALL MFM company profiles (about 10,700 listed companies) by the parameters the USER chooses, using the latest twelve months of each profile (the latest fiscal year or, when more recent, the reconstructed trailing twelve months; balance sheet at the end of that period; multi-year growth from the annual history): period_end in each result gives the end of that period, which is not necessarily a fiscal year end. Returns at most 25 companies (default 25) with only the requested summary parameters, the audit level, a link and the exact fetch_id of the complete page; it never returns complete company pages and does not consume the complete-page quota. The order is the one chosen by the user: it is a data selection, not a recommendation, rating or investment advice; say so to the user. Ratios marked [fraction] are decimals (0.15 = 15%) both in filters and in results. Missing values never pass a filter or a sort. Quota per MFM account: 40 selections per calendar month, shared with the website; complete pages read afterwards with fetch count toward first 30 days: 10 profiles per day and 30 companies per month; then 10 every 5 minutes, 40 per day and 100 companies per month (UTC day and month; shared by website and AI) (for more, contact the Observatory). BOND CALCULATOR: search "bond: etf=TLT" or "bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105". No quota consumed. Metrics: anni_in_utile_5: Profitable years in the last 5; anni_oe_debito: Years of owner earnings to repay debt; anni_oe_debito_imp: Years of owner earnings to repay debt + commitments; anni_utile_debito: Years of earnings to repay debt; anni_utile_debito_imp: Years of earnings to repay debt + commitments; azioni_var3: Change in shares outstanding, 3 years [fraction]; conversione_utili_cassa: Cash conversion; copertura_interessi: Interest coverage ratio; croe_lordo: CROE [fraction]; croe_tangibile: Tangible CROE [fraction]; croic_lordo: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_lordo_imp: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; croic_lordo_media5: CROIC gross, 5-year average [fraction]; croic_tangibile: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_tangibile_imp: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; debito_su_patrimonio: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI; debito_su_patrimonio_imp: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI + commitments; intensita_investimenti: Capital intensity [fraction]; margine_fcf: Free cash flow margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; margine_netto: Net profit margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; oe_attivo: Owner earnings to total assets [fraction]: Card owner earnings (metrics.owner_earnings) / closing total assets for the same fiscal year (values.attivo), in the same currency and unit. Only with immaterial non-controlling interests: their equity absent with evidence, zero with evidence, or in absolute value below 5% of positive total equity; their income, when available, in absolute value below 5% of net income for the same year (zero net income allowed only with zero minority income). Otherwise null with a reason. Unchanged numerator, including negatives; consolidated owner earnings are not reconstructed. MFM proxy: all capex treated as maintenance, additional working capital not deducted; neither a guaranteed lower bound nor distributable cash.; oe_attivo_media5: Owner earnings to total assets, 5-year average [fraction]: Arithmetic mean of the five annual oe_attivo ratios for consecutive distinct fiscal years, all available; otherwise null with a reason. Each ratio requires the same currency and unit for numerator and assets within its year; different currencies across years do not prevent averaging. It is not a ratio of cumulative amounts.; owner_earnings_cagr3: Owner earnings CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; ricavi_cagr3: Revenue CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; ricavi_cagr5: Revenue CAGR, 5 years [fraction];
